title: Parachutes 101
description: At the 56th Rescue Squadron at RAF Lakenheath, the Pararescuemen get a lot of respect and appreciation. But what about the Airmen behind the scenes? The Airmen packing the life- line for all the rescue squadron’s jumpers. The Airmen packing the parachutes.  Senior Airman Amanda Wowk reports. Includes sound bites from Tech. Sgt. Richard Hinojosa, 48 Operations Support Squadron Air Crew, Flight Equipment NCOIC.
keywords: RAF Lakenheath, parachutes, pararescue, Pararescuemen, 48th Fighter Wing, Riggers, sra amanda wowk, 48th fighter wing public affairs, 48th fw public affairs, paracute, Amanda Wowk, senior airman amanda wowk
